kb.a: Milk of Venus is Kenna's thousand-unit order: one hundred eighteen milliliter fill, price target six to eight dollars per unit. Aidan and Kenna are actively working the numbers by email. Next step is the full quote — ingredients plus packaging, labor, and overhead — once Sam gives the go.

Sam's single lane today: confirm the Atlas formula from Wednesday's Kenna meeting, green-light the full Milk of Venus quote, and give the one-word ads decision. Terra Lotus stays Aidan's lane, now Day 3 silent — escalation is at nine-thirty; send nothing customer-facing until Aidan reports back.

Terra Lotus is our biggest deal at seventy-eight thousand five hundred eighty dollars, fifty-two percent of the monthly target. Aidan owns the volume-pricing conversation and is now silent into a third business day — the Day-2 nudge was Tuesday, August eleventh. The Consultant escalates in the priority channel at nine-thirty this morning and texts Sam if Aidan stays dark. Send nothing customer-facing until Aidan reports.

Atlas Eternal is twenty-six thousand five hundred dollars for five thousand units. The thirteen thousand two hundred fifty dollar deposit is paid; the balance is due on completion. Production kicks off the moment Sam confirms the formula is in hand from Wednesday's Kenna meeting — no confirmation has come in yet.

Pure Good is roughly three hundred twenty-nine thousand dollars and advances off the same Kenna relationship. With the Kenna meeting now done, the next step is to schedule Pure Good's follow-up and quote.

Ashley Harmon at Apothik Skin replied this morning: she's booked tomorrow and will send call times for next week for the postbiotic moisturizer and balm project, one to three thousand units per SKU. Still warm — just a short delay before it's on the calendar.

Tasnim Broud at AYYUR is deciding on packaging for the ritual oil: a thirty milliliter frosted glass bottle with a gold dropper and cap. She doesn't have a vendor locked in and is open to PLL sourcing it. Keep moving her toward the three prototypes at two hundred fifty, five hundred, and a thousand units.

Nabil Saleh at CN1 Fragrance still wants four thousand-plus eight-ounce tubes of scented body lotion with his own fragrance oil supplied. No new reply in the sweep — still open to qualify formula, packaging, and timeline toward a quote.

Raul Guardado approved the final Struck Box version-five printing and asked for a status update. Laura already replied yesterday: we're waiting on a proof from the printer and will send it the moment it arrives. No action needed from Sam right now.
Charles Thompson at Brighten Path flagged that his beard balm and body wash samples never arrived. Carryover customer-care item — chase the shipment so it doesn't sour a live prospect.

Both net-new campaigns are on Maximize Conversions with no conversion tracking. One word from Sam, revert ads to manual, and the Consultant has the Ads Agent flip both to Manual CPC. The Google Ads data connection remains down on a retired API version, so live reporting stays dark until it's reconnected.

The production workflow is finalized: Sam approved the node-and-arrow flow map and a GMP sign-off page was added, now a nine-page package. It's done — say go and the Consultant builds the live CRM Production Pipeline.
Oreka, Nadia Dupuis, is closed and in production — eight thousand five hundred fifty-five dollars paid, thousand-unit peptide cream. Laura owns customer communication. No action needed.

The CRM browser session is logged out, which blocks live verification of developer fixes, Shopify sync, and the purchasing knowledge-base extraction. Sam logging back in as pll_tasklet_consultant unblocks all of it. No CRM developer replies came in overnight.

Victor Armendarez needs costing on two thousand units each of a curl-defining cream and an edge gel. It's overdue on Ronald's cost inputs — ingredients plus packaging, labor, and overhead before any quote goes out.

The OpenSend outbound engine is designed and waiting on Sam: buy three lookalike domains and a sending platform, create the separate Outbound Agent with its own login and memory off, and provide a booking calendar URL. Cold email only, never on the main domain; no cold texting.
Aidan's 7am Command Lab brief feed is live but Outlook-only right now because his WhatsApp and CRM are signed out on his machine. He needs to reconnect both to get the full picture.

Melissa Hilger of Busy Bee Vitality submitted a new skincare inquiry through the website contact form overnight (August thirteenth, 9pm). It's unqualified and not yet tied to any ad campaign — worth a quick follow-up today to see what she needs.

The Farmington Hills facility passed its final re-occupancy building and fire inspections on August thirteenth — both approved. UPS, USPS, and Shopify address changes and test-label/order paths in each system still remain pending; no new evidence yet that those were completed.
